title: Attach
summary: The sheet behind the composer's attach button: photos and videos, the camera, a file, a location, a sticker or a poll. Each choice hands over to the system picker or to its own screen.

canPoll.description: RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserSendMessage for the poll start event.

permissionProblem.description: photos: bipe_app_attach_photos_permission. camera: bipe_camera_permission_body. Each with a button to the app's system settings (bipe_contacts_open_settings on iOS, bipe_contacts_open_settings_android).

photos.effect: Opens the system photo picker (several photos and videos). The picked items open upload-preview.

camera.effect: Opens the system camera for a photo or a video. The result opens upload-preview.

file.effect: Opens the system file picker (one file). The file opens upload-preview.

location.effect: Closes the sheet and opens location-send.

sticker.effect: Closes the sheet and opens sticker-picker.

poll.effect: canPoll only: closes the sheet and opens poll-create (bipe-chat/bipe#569).

notes: The system pickers need no full library access: the iOS photo picker and the Android photo picker give only the chosen items. The permission problem shows only when the platform asks for access and the user said no.
Contacts as vCard are out of scope.
Order of rows: photos and videos, camera, file, location, sticker, poll.
